candidates.label: A
candidates.summary: Complete and well-scoped implementation with exact schema checks, non-mutating behavior, timeout validation, and passing visible/hidden tests. Minor URL validation weakness: it rejects uppercase HTTPS schemes and accepts some URLs containing whitespace.

candidates.label: B
candidates.summary: Strongest implementation. It validates exact v1/v2 shapes, rejects mixed and unknown fields, handles bool timeout/version correctly, validates HTTPS URLs more rigorously, preserves API and input mappings, and is supported by visible and hidden test passes.

candidates.label: C
candidates.summary: Complete and clean implementation with exact field validation and good endpoint/timeout checks. Minor correctness issue: v2 version accepts 2.0 because it only rejects bool and values not equal to 2, while the schema says version=2.

candidates.label: D

high.finding: v2 delivery.timeout_ms accepts any Real value that resolves to an integer, such as 500.0.
high.impact: The v2 schema uses timeout_ms as millisecond integer data; accepting floats weakens input type validation and can allow malformed configs that should raise ValueError.

candidates.summary: Mostly complete and project-native, with exact schema validation and solid endpoint checks. Main weakness is overly broad timeout_ms typing for v2.
